seeds.complete_def: COMPLETE iff the run's events reach iteration 7999 AND every Loss/value, success and time_out value in its last 200 iterations is finite AND that window holds a Loss/value value (Stand3's completeness check); the Loss/value instability count is reported, not gating
seeds.success_def: success = Stand3's seated test (centre over a deck by 2 cm, |y| < 0.10, within 2 cm of the seated height, speed < 0.05) AND cube tilt <= 8 deg, tilt = the angle between the cube's own z axis and world up (a 90-deg roll onto another face reads 90 deg and never seats) AND released (every robot-link normal force on the cube < 1.0 N, filtered contact sensor), all on the same step, for 12 consecutive steps
seeds.tilt_def: tilt = the angle between the cube's own z axis and world up (stand_mdp.body_z_tilt_deg via quat_order.unpack_wxyz), for both the 15-deg lift clause and the 8-deg success clause; a cube rolled 90 deg onto another face reads 90 deg, so it never earns the lift pay and never seats (the Stand3 replay's face tilt, the most vertical body axis, is not used: it reads a 90-deg roll as 0)
seeds.note: CubeToShelfStand4 (roll-proof lift): a different task from CubeToShelfStand3 and CubeToShelf; never compared with their numbers
seeds.labels: LEARNED crew policies (one PPO actor drives both robots, blind); ORACLE privileged observations exactly as Stand3: the actor's object_pos_a/b (simulator cube position in each robot's root frame) and the critic's base_lin_vel_a/b, object_lin_vel, object_ang_vel; MODIFIED hand colliders relative to Stand3 (both robots spawn from assets/cloth/berkeley_humanoid_lite_hand_colliders.usda)
seeds.rule: PREDECLARED RULE (frozen; Stand3's structure): the kill rule at model_1000 exactly as Stand3's launcher applies it (copy its condition and window verbatim); a seed is COMPLETE iff it reaches iteration 7999; Stand4 PASSES iff >= 1 of 2 seeds has last-200-iteration success >= 0.10, where success is the Stand4 termination above (seated, tilt <= 8 deg, released). Otherwise NEGATIVE; INCOMPLETE if a seed is neither complete nor stopped by the kill rule. Stand4 is a different task from Stand3 and CubeToShelf and is never compared with their numbers. Labels: LEARNED crew policies; ORACLE privileged observations exactly as Stand3 uses them (say which); MODIFIED hand colliders (the overlay) relative to Stand3.
